programme.title: Due East
programme.desc: A smart, hardworking high school senior has been an outsider for almost 4 years. When a fellow loner moves to Due East, she finds herself in a relationship for the first time, leading to a small town scandal that changes her life forever.

programme.title: Fielder's Choice
programme.desc: Drama with Chad Lowe. An advertising executive struggling to succeed in his professional career suddenly becomes a surrogate parent to his 8-year-old autistic nephew when his sister dies.

programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: A Bear Named Winnie
programme.desc: Based on the true story behind author A.A. Milne's beloved character, Winnie the Pooh, this is a tale of the remarkable friendship between a Canadian soldier and the cub that stood as a symbol of friendship and hope in a world plagued by war.

programme.title: DreamKeeper
programme.desc: Drama with August Schellenberg. A century-old storyteller and his grandson, a troubled 17-year-old boy, embark on a cross-country journey toward self-discovery.

programme.title: DreamKeeper
programme.desc: The film opens with Eagle Boy, a young man who is on a vision quest. It then cuts to the present, where a 17-year-old Lakota named Shane Chasing Horse is living on the Pine Ridge reservation. He is in trouble because he owes some money to a local gang—money he used to buy a beautiful ring for Mae Little Wounded, a girl he likes. Meanwhile, his mother asks him to drive his grandfather, Pete Chasing Horse, a storyteller, down to the powwow. Shane is reluctant. However, when the gang comes after him, Shane changes his mind and heads out to the powwow with his grandfather, who agrees to give him his truck once they reach the powwow. Grandfather tells Shane the story of a young Lakota man who tries to win the hand of Bluebird Woman. He also tells the story of how a thunder spirit falls in love with a Mohawk woman and brings her up into the ethereal world of Sky Woman, and of how she raised their son back in her village until he was struck by one of the villagers and brought back to live with his father.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: When a tsunami wipes Waikiki off the map, Dr. Hill's fears about the quake's after-effects are justified. Areas seismically quiet for centuries are awakened: Bald Mountain is engulfed in a deadly cloud of smoke and ash, boiling water rises from the earth, the Hoover Dam crumbles and Mount Rushmore explodes in a fiery burst of molten lava.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Las Vegas hotels have sunken into the ground, Dr. Hill and the remaining survivors are racing to escape, Meanwhile, the massive earthquake is threatening to split North America in half and the Nuclear Power plant is right in the path.

programme.title: Blackbeard
programme.desc: Action-packed historical drama starring Angus Macfadyen as the fearsome English pirate of the early 18th century known as Blackbeard. Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent from Great Britain to the seas surrounding the West Indies. His mission is to destroy an infamous pirate ship, known as The Queen Anne's Revenge, and to put an end to its villainous crew including the ill-famed Blackbeard. Also starring Mark Umbers and Jessica Chastain.

programme.title: Lives of the Saints
programme.desc: Vittorio Innocente, a young man, estranged from the tragedies of his Italian immigrant family, has spent his adult life denying his past. When his estranged father starts to stalk Vittorio's sister, Rita, with murderous intent, Vittorio is moved to return to his family and uncover the decades-old secrets that have torn his family apart.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. What he promises to reveal to Ainslie is the truth behind the crimes and the reason he confessed to the one crime Ainslie doesn't even believe he committed. What unfolds between the two men is a serpentine trail into both men's pasts based on the bestseller from master storyteller Arthur Hailey.

programme.title: Just Desserts
programme.desc: Passionate Italian baker Marco Poloni enters a baking competition entitled "The Golden Whisk" to attract publicity and win prize money to support his struggling family-owned bakery in the Bronx. He asks for the help of uptight Manhattan-based pastry-maker Grace Carpenter. The unlikely pair must win to pursue their dreams and to show up an old rival of Poloni's who has also entered the competition. Along the way Marco and Grace seem to find a mutual attraction for each other.

programme.title: The Poseidon Adventure
programme.desc: A cruise ship succumbs to a terrorist act and capsizes on New Year's eve. A ragtag group of survivors, spearheaded by a Priest and a homeland security agent, must journey through the upside down vessel and attempt an escape.

programme.title: The Poseidon Adventure

programme.title: Charms for the Easy Life
programme.desc: Drama with Gena Rowlands. The story of three women who live in a North Carolina town and defy the traditional roles set forth for them by society.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.desc: Drugged-out Shaun Ryder (Walliams) and classically-trained dancer and musical star Bez (Lucas) discuss their roots, daily living routine and a rather nice package holiday they went on. (24 December 2000).

programme.title: Flood
programme.desc: Flood is a disaster film set in London and Scotland. Estranged meteorologist father Leonard and Marine Engineer son are caught up in a weather related catastrophe...

programme.title: Good Fences
programme.desc: Good Fences is about an upwardly-mobile Black family for whom the American dream becomes a nightmare. In the 1970s, Tom Spader is an attorney who is determined to end what he has dubbed "the colored man's losing streak." When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.title: Where There's a Will
programme.desc: A hapless grifter stands to inherit a small fortune from his estranged grandmother if he travels to Harmony, Texas to live with her. Instead of a short road to easy money, he finds a soft spot in his heart for the little town and unconditional love from his only living relative.

programme.title: Casanova
programme.desc: He was the world's most notorious seducer. A swashbuckler, master of disguise and wit - it was said no woman could resist Casanova's amorous charms. Until now. For the first time in his life, the legendary Casanova (Heath Ledger) is about to meet his match with an alluring Ventian beauty, Francesca (Sienna Miller), who does the one thing he never thought possible: refuse him. Through a series of clever disguises and scheming ruses, he manages to get ever closer to Francesca. But he is playing the most dangerous game he has ever encountered - one that will risk not only his life and reputation, but his only chance at true passion.

programme.title: Annie's Point
programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

programme.title: Falling in Love with the Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Bridget Connolly (Patty Duke) and Betsy Lucas (Shelley Long) are two social climbing society women from Santa Catalina Island, California who have been continuous rivals for some unknown reason. But when Betsy's son Mark falls in love with the girl next door—who happens to be Bridget's daughter Theresa—the two women put all of their energy in to planning the wedding, much to the chagrin of their children.

programme.title: The Circus
programme.desc: Welsh drama. Set in 1848, this is the story of a young girl who is bewitched by the excitement of the travelling circus as it visits her small town in west Wales.

programme.title: Two Fathers: Justice for the Innocent
programme.desc: Two fathers from very different backgrounds reunite after eight years to pursue the escaped drug dealer responsible for the deaths of their son and daughter.

programme.title: Out of the Woods
programme.desc: Drama with Jason London. A self-absorbed young lawyer with ties to the material things in life gets an eye-opening experience when he visits his nature-loving grandfather.

programme.title: On Thin Ice / Breaking Through
programme.desc: Lucia Lobo is a nurse that cannot have children, so she stole 3 babies from the hospital. Filipe, her husband is fooled by thinking he's the one who can't have kids. When her children start to unveil the past, problems begin.

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: Ronald Reagan turned from a liberal movie star to an exceptionally conservative politician and stunned the nation when he became governor of the largest state. The Reagans skilfully used American myth-making to rise to power. This documentary also takes a look at the relentless shift to the right of business, prompting Reagan to become a champion of a contained government.

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: An analysis of Reagan's view of the race issue and his role as an advocate of authority and order who used racist strategies to win elections. The similarities with the current political landscape and the tactics employed by some Republicans are striking. Nancy also comes to the fore as a political force.

programme.title: A Bear Named Winnie
programme.desc: Based on the true story behind author A.A. Milne's beloved character, Winnie the Pooh, this is a tale of the remarkable friendship between a Canadian soldier and the cub that stood as a symbol of friendship and hope in a world plagued by war.

programme.title: Prairie Fever
programme.desc: Western adventure starring Kevin Sorbo and Dominique Swain. A drunken former lawman is given the chance to clear his debts by escorting three eccentric women back East. (2008).

programme.title: The Hot Potato
programme.desc: London's East End 1969. Based on real events. Two chancers "find" a lump of Uranium and crisscross Europe to find a buyer. Accompanied by Danny's girl,the lovely Carole. They encounter a diverse cast of bizarre characters, all trying to steal the 'Hot Potato', but a deal agreed inside the Vatican has the co-conspirators confounding each other. The story twists and turns to an exciting and unexpected finale.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: The group arrives in Paris, where Isabelle confronts her past while growing closer to Daryl; Codron seeks help from the leader of a growing nationalist movement called Pouvoir, putting the Union of Hope and Laurent under dangerous scrutiny.

programme.title: Scott Turow's Reversible Errors
programme.desc: A corporate lawyer's interest in a decade-old murder case is piqued by a new confession that could clear the convicted killer, who sits on death row.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: An investigation of a dead daughter begins when a military contractor Lex Walker (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles and he finds the body is not his daughter's. Lex Walker, a British mercenary battling in Afghanistan who drops everything to hurry to Los Angeles when he is informed that his daughter Samantha, who he has not seen in many years, has been found dead. When he arrives at the morgue to identify the body, he is for some reason unsurprised to discover that it is not hers. So he begins a one-man investigation into her whereabouts, trailed by the suspicious detective (Jason Patric) assigned to the case. He soon makes his way to Samantha's boss, Karl Schuster (James Caan), the millionaire CEO of a high-tech company who offers sympathy but little help. It quickly becomes obvious that Schuster is hiding something, since he displays no hesitation about shooting one of his henchmen to death in his own office. Aided by a sexy barmaid (Shannon Elizabeth) enticed by his offer of a $10,000 finder's fee, the take-no-prisoners Lex sets out getting to the bottom of the mystery, beating up or shooting the myriad human obstacles who get in his way. It all leads to his discovery of a massive identity-theft scheme engineered by Schuster about which Lex's very much alive daughter (Melissa Ordway) has the goods.

programme.title: Blackbeard
programme.desc: Action-packed historical drama starring Angus Macfadyen as the fearsome English pirate of the early 18th century known as Blackbeard. Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent from Great Britain to the seas surrounding the West Indies. His mission is to destroy an infamous pirate ship, known as The Queen Anne's Revenge, and to put an end to its villainous crew including the ill-famed Blackbeard. Also starring Mark Umbers and Jessica Chastain.

programme.title: DreamKeeper
programme.desc: The film opens with Eagle Boy, a young man who is on a vision quest. It then cuts to the present, where a 17-year-old Lakota named Shane Chasing Horse is living on the Pine Ridge reservation. He is in trouble because he owes some money to a local gang—money he used to buy a beautiful ring for Mae Little Wounded, a girl he likes. Meanwhile, his mother asks him to drive his grandfather, Pete Chasing Horse, a storyteller, down to the powwow. Shane is reluctant. However, when the gang comes after him, Shane changes his mind and heads out to the powwow with his grandfather, who agrees to give him his truck once they reach the powwow. Grandfather tells Shane the story of a young Lakota man who tries to win the hand of Bluebird Woman. He also tells the story of how a thunder spirit falls in love with a Mohawk woman and brings her up into the ethereal world of Sky Woman, and of how she raised their son back in her village until he was struck by one of the villagers and brought back to live with his father.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The pressure on Elizabeth grows as there is still no marriage and consequently no heir to the throne. Elizabeth fears that her cousin Mary Queen of Scots, recently widowed, might claim her right to the throne of England. However she is resolute in thinking that she can rule alone. Meanwhile she continues to meet Robert Dudley. When his wife dies, rumors spread that Elizabeth might be behind her death. Details of a plot to replace Elizabeth with Mary are uncovered by Walsingham. Even the Duke of Norfolk seems to be involved and is subsequently sent to the tower.

programme.title: Casanova
programme.desc: He was the world's most notorious seducer. A swashbuckler, master of disguise and wit - it was said no woman could resist Casanova's amorous charms. Until now. For the first time in his life, the legendary Casanova (Heath Ledger) is about to meet his match with an alluring Ventian beauty, Francesca (Sienna Miller), who does the one thing he never thought possible: refuse him. Through a series of clever disguises and scheming ruses, he manages to get ever closer to Francesca. But he is playing the most dangerous game he has ever encountered - one that will risk not only his life and reputation, but his only chance at true passion.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Stambulo „Fenerbahçe“ - Kauno „Žalgiris“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Playoffs G3
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.desc: While engaging in a fight with his nemesis, Dr. Eggman, Sonic the Hedgehog destroys the Paradox Prism, an ancient artifact with immense power. This causes a ripple in the space-time continuum, separating Sonic from his friends and sending him to New Yoke City, a dystopian version of Green Hills in a parallel universe ruled by five Eggman variants. Traveling through his new surroundings, Sonic is confronted by Nine, a variant of his best friend Tails who constructed mechanized tails as weapons against his childhood bullies, not having a Sonic to help him. Sonic earns Nine's trust, and the young genius modifies Sonic's shoes and gloves to attune to the new energy in his body from the Prism. However, Sonic and Nine are captured, and Sonic is taken for tests run by Rusty Rose, a variant of Amy Rose turned into a subservient cyborg. When the variants threaten Nine, Sonic overworks his powers, causing him to generate a massive amount of energy. However, he notices what seems to be a hallucination of his rival Shadow the Hedgehog during this surge and flashbacks to an earlier confrontation with him.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: "The Most Dangerous Game Night:Marlene plans a game night to help the zoo animals bond but it takes a terrible turn when the snacks run out. While Kowalski, Maurice, and Mort go on a snack run the gaming animals begin to fight over the games - cheating, sore losing, unwilling participation… chaos! The snack runners get trapped by the law at the store, and the zoo animals have to reconcile quickly in order to pull off a risky rescue. This isn't the kind of bonding Marlene had in mind! Street Smarts: Elmer the dog wants a friend, and thinks he found one in Mort. The penguins are compelled to rescue him, but Elmer doesn't want to give the little lemur up! Max the cat is recruited to help, and Max uses his dog expertise to lead the boys to the giant dog. Mort is rescued, but at what cost? The penguins think Max has met his slobbery doom in the jaws of the giant mastiff.".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "Time Out: Kowalski's invention that stops time falls into the worst hands possible. King Julien's. The lemur promptly breaks it trapping the two of them in a world frozen in time. Instead of being a disaster, however, they realize they can do everything their hearts desire invent like crazy, perform on Broadway, play tennis in the middle of the street. But even an infinite playland like this can't last forever! Our Man in Grrfurjiclestan: Special Agent Buck Rockgut makes a "triumphant" return. While hunting the Red Squirrel across the globe, the crusty old bird contacts the penguins with a warning that the diabolical squirrel has a brainwashed sleeper agent among them. They battle each other to a standstill to uncover the agent - will it tear the unit apart? Can trust ever be restored? They have to take a trip to a faraway borough to uncover the truth.".

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: "SpongeBob adopts a stray worm, and to his surprise, the worm gives birth to some worm babies overnight! But since Gary won't play nice, SpongeBob needs to find loving homes for his new slimey, weird-looking friends. / Plankton is sick of Karen's criticisms, so he decides he can just replace her with some new computer inventions! But when he takes them out on a Krabby Patty formula-stealing mission, he learns that Karen truly is one of a kind".

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! So when Squidward tells him that there are a lot of rules that he doesn't know about-like never interrupting Squidward's naps-SpongeBob is eager to learn and follow everything he says. Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Monster High: Haunted

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

Durante la ricreazione nel cortile di una scuola elementare, nel periodo di Natale, un bambino musulmano rompe una finestra con una pietra e ferisce lievemente un bidello. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.desc: 2 Oscar al biopic su Ray Charles con Jamie Foxx. Dall'infanzia al successo, passando per i suoi controversi lati oscuri, la vita del leggendario "The Genius" della musica black.

programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: L'ombra di Caravaggio

programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.title: Gli ultimi saranno ultimi
programme.desc: Dramma sociale di Massimiliano Bruno con Paola Cortellesi e Alessandro Gassmann. La vita di una donna, licenziata perche' incinta, si intreccia con quella di un poliziotto tormentato.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Barry Seal - Una storia americana

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Il ritratto del Duca
programme.desc: Commedia biografica con Jim Broadbent, Helen Mirren e Matthew Goode. Londra: un tassista ruba un prezioso quadro dalla National Gallery e chiede al governo un riscatto inconsueto.

programme.desc: La genesi ossessiva della celebre partitura di Maurice Ravel nel biopic di Anne Fontaine. La vita, la carriera e il tormento creativo dell'artista, fino al suo capolavoro musicale.

programme.desc: 3 premi Oscar 2022 al remake di Sian Heder premiato al Sundance. Ruby, unica udente in una famiglia di sordomuti, sogna un futuro nel canto ma non vuole lasciare i suoi cari.

programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: The Last Rifleman - Ritorno in Normandia
programme.desc: Pellicola Sky Original con Pierce Brosnan protagonista. Un veterano della Seconda guerra mondiale fugge dalla casa di cura per partecipare al 75 anniversario dello sbarco in Normandia.

programme.desc: War-dramedy di Gianni Zanasi con Edoardo Leo, Miriam Leone, Giuseppe Battiston. La guerra tra Italia e Spagna unisce le vite di un allevatore di vongole e della figlia di un politico.

programme.title: Il quinto potere
programme.desc: Il fenomeno WikiLeaks nel thriller biografico con Benedict Cumberbatch. La storia della piattaforma online e del suo fondatore Julian Assange che ha fatto tremare i governi del mondo.

programme.desc: Judi Dench nella storia di una spia del KGB. Sottoposta a interrogatorio, l'insospettabile vedova Joan Stanley ripercorre la sua lunga militanza al servizio del regime comunista.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.sub-title: Le cose non dette e Poker Face
programme.desc: Analisi della pellicola di Gabriele Muccino sulla fragilità delle relazioni e della serie che reinterpreta il giallo-poliziesco.

programme.title: Nel nome del padre
programme.desc: Biopic con Daniel Day-Lewis ed Emma Thompson diretti da Jim Sheridan, Orso d'oro a Berlino. La drammatica vicenda giudiziaria di 4 irlandesi condannati ingiustamente per terrorismo.

programme.title: Le Mans '66 - La grande sfida
programme.desc: Due Oscar per il biopic di James Mangold con Christian Bale e Matt Damon, sulla storica sfida tra Ford e Ferrari. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: Il caso Spotlight
programme.desc: Due Oscar al dramma d'inchiesta con Mark Ruffalo, Rachel McAdams e Michael Keaton. Un team di giornalisti di Boston indaga sugli abusi sessuali perpetrati da oltre 70 sacerdoti.

programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Kate Winslet, vincitrice del Golden Globe, in un dramma coniugale diretto da Sam Mendes, che racconta la crisi di una coppia borghese nell'America degli anni 50.

programme.title: Soldado
programme.desc: Stefano Sollima dirige Benicio Del Toro e Josh Brolin nel sequel di "Sicario". Ingaggiato dall'FBI, un uomo misterioso intensifica la guerra al narcotraffico fra Messico e Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - Il ritorno del Re
programme.desc: 11 Oscar al terzo capitolo della saga tolkeniana di Peter Jackson. Le forze di Sauron preparano l'attacco finale. Frodo e Sam si dirigono verso Monte Fato per distruggere l'Anello.

programme.title: Speciale: Rosa Elettrica
programme.desc: Maria Chiara Giannetta e Francesco di Napoli in fuga attraverso l'Italia: un dietro le quinte svela retroscena, location e scene action della serie.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - La guerra dei Rohirrim
programme.desc: Prodotto da Peter Jackson, il prequel in stile anime della trilogia de "Il Signore degli Anelli". Il Re Helm Hammerhand e il suo esercito organizzano un'ardua resistenza all'interno della Roccaforte di Hornburg per fronteggiare l'assalto di Wulf, Signore di Dunland, in cerca di vendetta dopo la morte del padre.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - La compagnia dell'anello
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Peter Jackson dal romanzo di J.R.R. Tolkien. Un giovane hobbit entra in possesso di un anello dai poteri straordinari.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - Le due Torri
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al secondo capitolo della saga di Peter Jackson, dal romanzo di J.R.R. Tolkien. Dopo la scissione della Compagnia dell'Anello, Gollum insegue Frodo e Sam, diretti a Mordor.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - Il ritorno del Re
programme.desc: 11 Oscar al terzo capitolo della saga tolkeniana di Peter Jackson. Le forze di Sauron preparano l'attacco finale. Frodo e Sam si dirigono verso Monte Fato per distruggere l'Anello.

programme.desc: 4 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Peter Jackson dal romanzo di J.R.R. Tolkien. Un giovane hobbit entra in possesso di un anello dai poteri straordinari.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci portano alla scoperta dell'epica trilogia di Peter Jackson, disponibile su Sky Cinema e Sky On Demand.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.title: Il gatto con gli stivali
programme.desc: Il celebre felino e' il protagonista dello spin-off della saga di Shrek. Dopo una rapina finita male, l'amicizia fra Gatto e Humpty Dumpty si e' rotta, ma il destino li fara' rincontrare.

programme.title: Dora e la città perduta
programme.desc: Fiaba con Isabela Moner, live-action della serie Nickelodeon. La giovane Dora parte con il cugino e la fedele scimmia per ritrovare i genitori nella leggendaria citta' Inca di Parapata.

programme.title: Giu' per il tubo
programme.desc: Avventure e sfrenata comicita' in un'animazione targata DreamWorks. Londra: per liberarsi di un roditore dei bassifondi, un raffinato topo 'da salotto' finisce nelle fogne di Ratropolis.

programme.title: La Befana vien di notte II - Le origini
programme.desc: Prequel con Monica Bellucci, Fabio De Luigi e Zoe Massenti tra avventure e incantesimi. Una giovane orfana entra in conflitto con un avido barone, ma una strega gentile la salvera'.

programme.title: I Croods
programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.title: I Croods 2 - Una nuova era
programme.desc: Seconda avventura animata per gli sprizzanti cavernicoli. Dopo aver accolto il giovane Guy, i Croods vanno in cerca di un luogo chiamato ‘casa’. Una volta trovato, dovranno fare i conti con i suoi abitanti, l'evoluto clan dei Superior, finché una nuova minaccia non porterà le due famiglie a unire le loro forze.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: La West Coast, dove i lupi perlustrano le coste, le lontre si tuffano tra le onde, le balenottere azzurre si rincorrono e fanno capriole e i polpi compiono un sacrificio estremo per i loro piccoli.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: La Patagonia è una regione selvaggia all'estremità meridionale delle Americhe. Sulle sue spettacolari montagne innevate si nascondono i pericolosissimi puma, mentre nelle sue immense praterie si aggirano i nandù.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: I Croods
programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.title: Rosa Elettrica - Giannetta Vs Di Napoli
programme.desc: Maria Chiara Giannetta e Francesco Di Napoli ripercorrono la loro esperienza durante le riprese, tra aneddoti divertenti e curiosita' dal backstage.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Blockbuster di Halloween per tutta la famiglia. Il Conte Dracula organizza una festa per il compleanno della figlia Mavis, ma tra gli ospiti c'e' un intruso...

programme.title: 10 Lives - Un Gatto Fortunato
programme.desc: Divertente animazione targata Sky Original. Dopo aver perso la sua nona e ultima vita, al pigro micio Becket non resta che supplicare un'ultima possibilità al guardiano del Paradiso.

programme.title: Speciale - Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Luca Argentero e il cast presentano l'Avvocato Ligas, penalista anticonvenzionale sempre pronto a rischiare pur di vincere una causa.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: La West Coast, dove i lupi perlustrano le coste, le lontre si tuffano tra le onde, le balenottere azzurre si rincorrono e fanno capriole e i polpi compiono un sacrificio estremo per i loro piccoli.

programme.title: Chi ha incastrato Babbo Natale?
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Christian De Sica, Diletta Leotta e Angela Finocchiaro. Per far fallire Babbo Natale, un'azienda infiltra un truffatore al Polo Nord.

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un film d'animazione con le allegre creature dal ciuffo ribelle. La principessa Poppy e il malinconico Branch devono salvare i Trolls dai loro mortali nemici.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda
programme.desc: Fiaba di arti marziali con un simpatico e goloso panda. Secondo un'antica profezia, Po sarebbe il prescelto 'Guerriero del Dragone'. Si affida così a un severo maestro di Kung Fu.

programme.title: Hook - Capitan Uncino
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman e Julia Roberts in un film di Steven Spielberg. Peter, ormai adulto, deve tornare sull’Isola che non c'e' per ritrovare i suoi figli, rapiti da Capitan Uncino.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Il giro del mondo in 80 giorni
programme.desc: Colorato adattamento animato del capolavoro di Jules Verne. La scimmietta Passepartout e il ranocchio Phileas partono per un folle viaggio per battere il record di un famoso esploratore.

programme.title: 10 Lives - Un Gatto Fortunato
programme.desc: Divertente animazione targata Sky Original. Dopo aver perso la sua nona e ultima vita, al pigro micio Becket non resta che supplicare un'ultima possibilità al guardiano del Paradiso.

programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Christian De Sica, Diletta Leotta e Angela Finocchiaro. Per far fallire Babbo Natale, un'azienda infiltra un truffatore al Polo Nord.

programme.title: Paws of Fury: La leggenda di Hank
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura animata targata Sky Original. Hank, un adorabile cane che sogna di diventare samurai, prende lezioni da un maestro, ma un perfido gatto minaccia il villaggio.

programme.title: Genitori vs Influencer
programme.desc: Fabio Volo, Ginevra Francesconi e Giulia De Lellis nella commedia Sky Original di Michela Andreozzi. Un prof si scontra con la figlia teenager per colpa dei social... ma diventa influencer.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: Il marchio DreamWorks su un film d'animazione tratto dai libri a fumetti per bambini di Dav Pilkey. Feriti in un incidente, un cane poliziotto e il suo collega umano sono sottoposti a un intervento che li fonde insieme. Nasce Dog Man, creatura ibrida al servizio della città contro un malvagio gatto arancione.

programme.title: Hook - Capitan Uncino
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman e Julia Roberts in un film di Steven Spielberg. Peter, ormai adulto, deve tornare sull’Isola che non c'e' per ritrovare i suoi figli, rapiti da Capitan Uncino.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Trolls World Tour
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo d'animazione con le bambole targate Dreamworks. Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Sing 2 - Sempre più forte
programme.desc: Sequel di successo del musical animato targato Illumination. Il koala Buster Moon e i suoi amici affrontano ogni imprevisto per esibirsi nel prestigioso Crystal Tower Theater.

programme.title: La musica nel cuore - August Rush
programme.desc: Freddie Highmore e Robin Williams in un film toccante e magico. Il piccolo August, prodigio della musica, suona per le strade di New York sperando di rintracciare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Biancaneve
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e' la Regina Cattiva in un'irriverente versione della famosa fiaba. Dopo la morte del padre, Biancaneve deve affrontare la perfida matrigna. Sara' aiutata da 7 nanetti briganti.

programme.title: Biancaneve e il cacciatore
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart, Chris Hemsworth e Charlize Theron nella rilettura della famosa fiaba. La crudele regina incarica un cacciatore di uccidere la figliastra Biancaneve, in fuga verso il bosco.

programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

Indagando sull'accaduto scopre che altri animali sono stati sottoposti allo stesso trattamento. Un lupo e un coccodrillo stanno andando incontro alla medesima alterazione di George: serve al più presto un antidoto per fermare la loro rabbia distruttrice.

Keller lo assume come istruttore e mette a segno il colpo proprio durante una delle lezioni di guida. Cosi' Roberts si ritrova con le spalle al muro: costretto a usare tutta la sua abilita' per sfuggire alla polizia.

programme.title: Monaco 1988 - F1

programme.title: Magic Temple
programme.desc: The magical world of \"Samadhi\" is threatened by the evil forces of Ravenal and Sifu sends out three teenage boys to journey on the Magic Temple. Jubal, Sambag, and Omar, each with their own unique power battle the threat to the world of Samadhi and along the way face many extraordinary things. The boys are sure to face a huge battle ahead of them but with the help of magical creatures they met along their journey, evil is eliminated and they learn the true value of camaraderie and believing in themselves to face any problem.

programme.title: Loving In Tandem
programme.desc: Shine is a jolly and happy-go-lucky girl who will do anything for her family. But when it comes to love. she hopelessly finds one, and wishes to meet her one true love. Until one day when she was praying to meet the love of her life, she unexpectedly meets Luke, a rebellious and grumpy Filipino-American boy who was sent to the Philippines by his parents from the United States.

programme.title: The Super Parental Guardians
programme.desc: A family movie that revolves around unlikely \"parents\" Arci and Paco. Arci gains custody of his best friend's children Megan and Ernie just before she dies. The children's uncle, Paco, has no choice but to join this newfound family. Arci and Paco will now embark on the craziest and greatest adventure of their lives as they play the roles of Momshie and Popshie to both Megan and Ernie.

programme.title: I Love You, Hater
programme.desc: Joko is a boy trying to help his family survive, while Zoey is a girl hoping to prove herself to the world. Opportunity rises when Sasha is looking to hire a new personal assistant. Just one catch - they have to compete against each other! Will their own goals prevail, or will they set aside their differences and find true happiness and love in the end?

programme.title: Kung Kaya Mo, Kaya Ko Rin
The Annulment
programme.desc: It follows Gari and Sherwin who come from two different worlds. They meet, they fell in love and they get married. Years later, what they had is now shattered into pieces and Gari wants an annulment with Sherwin so she can pursue what was lost in her in the years they were together.
